notes.title: Bot Gaiden is Released!
notes.notes:
Bot Gaiden is now available! Run, jump, and slice your way through Giorqio's minions and Hench-bots! Quick, they're getting stronger as we speak. Grab a friend for co-op fun, with skill balancing it doesn't matter how "good" they are. Multiple difficulty levels, lots of unlockables. Come join the fun!

notes.title: Bot Gaiden releases April 22
notes.notes:
After several years of development, SwordSwipe Studios is proud to bring you Bot Gaiden!  We've been working hard to make this dream a reality, and we can't wait to share it with you. Get ready for a challenging, vibrant, fast paced romp through our robot world. 

Mark your calendars for April 22, 2022!

notes.title: Cartoon Ninja Robot Speedrunning - Bosses Gain Health With Time
notes.notes:
Execution over exploration. Everything is in front of you, nothing is hidden. Your mission is to find the most efficient path through the hordes of enemies on your way to defeating each of Giorqio's Hench-Bots. Single-hit kills to keep the pace moving. 

Momentum is key. Collecting Skill Gears improves your efficiency. Keeping them leads to speed boosts. Fast finishes enable upgrades. Upgrades enable faster finishes. You'll go from stock robot to superpowered turbocharger in no time!

Bring a friend, no matter their skill level. Auto Speed Adjustment keeps you from falling behind your partner. Skill Gears automatically apply to both players. Teleport to each other for support. Tag-Team the opposition with the devastating BotSwat!
